ارتقبتن (form VIII)
# اِرْتَقَبْتُنَّ (irtaqabtunna) /ir.ta.qab.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# اُرْتُقِبْتُنَّ (urtuqibtunna) /ur.tu.qib.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
